ablation.name: phase4i2a_sota_heun
ablation.notes: Phase 4I.2a: SOTA (4H.1g) + Heun solver. STRUCTURAL: higher-order ODE solver. Theory: Euler has O(h^2) local truncation error, Heun (improved Euler) has O(h^3). Same num_steps=8, but trajectory is more accurate. Predictor: v1=f(h,t_curr); h_pred=h+v1*dt. Corrector: v2=f(h_pred,t_next); h=h+(v1+v2)/2*dt. Cost: 2x forward calls per step. Goal: more accurate ODE trajectory -> better style injection precision. If effective, can reduce num_steps (faster inference).
